title: Klipper history concept is incompatible with private Activity
line: Text you copy while in a private activity is no longer kept in the clipboard history.
explanation: Klipper knew nothing about activities, so everything copied in an activity set to not track usage was added to the clipboard history like anywhere else, and since the history moved to an on-disk database it stayed there across sessions. The activity manager keeps the private activities in a list in kactivitymanagerd-pluginsrc. Klipper now checks that list for the current activity whenever the clipboard changes and, if the activity is private, handles the copy the same way as a password: it stays on the clipboard but is not stored, and the popup shows the existing "sensitive data" notice with its Clear button.

commits.message:
klipper: don't keep history of what is copied in a private activity

Activities can be set to not track usage, but everything copied in one
still ended up in the clipboard history, which is also saved on disk.
Now it is kept out of the history and treated as sensitive data instead.

BUG: 391046

media.caption: Master, activity set to private: the copied text is stored at the top of the clipboard history.
With the fix, same private activity: the copy pastes normally but is not in the history; the popup says the clipboard holds data that won't be stored.

reviews.text: Reusing Klipper's existing sensitive-data/password handling for private activities is a good UX choice because it keeps prior non-private history intact while keeping private copies out of the history and SQLite database. However, checking isInPrivateActivity() before the selectionMode && !m_bSaveSelection branch causes merely highlighting text with the mouse in a private activity to set m_selectionHasPassword = true, which shows the sensitive-data banner unexpectedly and leaves it stuck even after switching to a normal activity and copying with Ctrl+C. Additionally, reparsing kactivitymanagerd-pluginsrc synchronously from disk on every clipboard and selection change adds unnecessary GUI-thread I/O in plasmashell.
changes: Do not set m_selectionHasPassword = true on primary selection in a private activity when selectionMode && !m_bSaveSelection && !m_bSynchronize; instead return early (skipping selectionForAction) so highlighting text in a private activity neither triggers a spurious sensitive-data banner nor leaves it stuck after Ctrl+C in a normal activity.

Cache the off-the-record-activities list from kactivitymanagerd-pluginsrc and watch the file for changes (e.g. with KDirWatch from KF6::CoreAddons) instead of calling KSharedConfig::openConfig and reparseConfiguration() synchronously on every clipboard/selection event.
